reviewSummary: ACCEPT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. The mode-0444 subject remained at the required digest on D-288 HEAD. All 28 recorded filesystem pins and all 29 structured path/digest assertions reproduce; the subject plus all 25 recorded JSON inputs pass strict duplicate-key and non-RFC-constant rejection. Frozen g12 leftover-join.v4, occupancy v6, doctor-actor leftover-join.v12, and doctor-actor leftover-join.v11 remain at their dispatched digests and modes. V5 preserves v4's exact six-obligation partition, singleton leftoverDesign [OBL-DOCTOR-FX-AUTHORING], and twelve-member occupancy corpus; it leaves occupancy v6 current and updates the separate DR-114 source from historical doctor v11 to current doctor v12, whose seven-member leftover set is list-identical to v11. G12 leftover v4 remains current at draft time and becomes historical only after this successor is recorded. The candidate lands nothing, binds NOTHING, executes nothing, occupies no identifier, invents no prohibited bytes or adjacent protocol object, changes no status token or required-now count, opens no Class A, satisfies no row, edits neither protected file, and authorizes no implementation.
